name: 162 games
about: MVP Baseball 2005's own schedule: the real 2005 season, then 2006 and 2007.
short: The real 2005 season, then 2006 and 2007, as the game ships.

name: 64 games
about: Made for MVP05-Plus by spy_jam. Every team plays 32 at home and 32 away, about a third of its games in its division, two against its interleague rival and 13 to 15 other interleague games. First half from early April to mid-May, All-Star Game in July, second half from August 1, after the trade deadline.
short: Made for MVP05-Plus: even home and away for everyone, the All-Star Game in July, a real trade deadline.

name: 60 games
about: MVP Baseball 2004's 60-game schedule, brought over by MVP05-Plus (Montreal's games are Washington's). 30 games from early April, the All-Star Game in July, 30 more from August 1, after the trade deadline. No interleague games; a few teams play 28 at home and 32 away, as in 2004.
short: MVP 2004's own: 30 games before the trade deadline, the All-Star Game, 30 after. No interleague.

name: 30 games
about: MVP Baseball 2004's 30-game schedule, brought over by spy_jam. 15 games in April, 15 more from mid-August, after the trade deadline. No interleague games.
short: MVP 2004's own: 15 games in April, 15 after the trade deadline. No interleague.

name: 15 games
about: MVP Baseball 2004's 15-game schedule, brought over by MVP05-Plus: the whole season in April, with the All-Star Game in the middle. No interleague games; a few teams play 9 at home and 6 away, as in 2004.
short: MVP 2004's own: the whole season in April. No interleague.
